Right column (wide): exactly five identical white Brazilian three-pin sockets stacked vertically from top to bottom, each a raised, horizontally elongated hexagon with three round holes in a row, the middle hole slightly higher. One single round white cable comes out of the top edge of the strip, above the sockets. No logo, no printed text, no other colors, no other ports, no other buttons on the strip.
